title: Counselor Desk Reference: Good Faith Estimate Cap on Charges Enrolled in Patient Payment Plans
content:
When a charge posted for an encounter already enrolled on a proposed Patient Payment Plans plan is enrolled, the charge amount counted toward the enrolled amount is capped by the estimate given before the service.

**The cap applied at the desk.**

- On the Self-Pay Account, where the charge carries an estimate above 0.00, the counted amount is capped at that estimate plus the Good Faith Estimate dispute threshold of the patient's Patient Financial Account (the amount the account's financial class sets by which a billed total must exceed its Good Faith Estimate for the billed-versus-estimate dispute).
- On any other financial class, where the charge carries an estimate above 0.00, the counted amount is capped at the estimate multiplied by 1.25 and rounded half up to the cent.
- A charge carrying no estimate is counted at its full amount.

A cap means the counted amount is the lower of the charge amount and the cap. The part of a charge above the cap stays on the financial account's standard statements.

**Records read.** The financial class of the Patient Financial Account, the charge amount and the estimate carried on the charge.

| Financial class of the Patient Financial Account | Estimate on the charge | Counted amount |
|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Account | Above 0.00 | The lower of the charge amount and the estimate plus the account's Good Faith Estimate dispute threshold |
| Any other class | Above 0.00 | The lower of the charge amount and the estimate multiplied by 1.25, rounded half up to the cent |
| Any class | None | The full charge amount |

**Examples (hypothetical amounts).**

- Commercial PPO/POS Account, estimate 400.00, charge 560.00: the cap is 500.00; the counted amount is 500.00 and 60.00 stays on the standard statements.
- The same class and estimate, charge 480.00: the charge is below the cap of 500.00; the counted amount is 480.00.
- Self-Pay Account, estimate 400.00, charge 900.00, on an account whose dispute threshold figure were 250.00: the cap is 650.00 and the counted amount is 650.00.
- Any class, a charge of 350.00 carrying no estimate: the counted amount is 350.00.
